domestic.comment: 코스피 5.8% 폭락, 6,471.17로 마감(-398.66p). 장중 6,400.81까지 추락하며 6,400선을 위협, 매도 사이드카 발동. 외국인 3조4,883억원·기관 1조3,244억원 '쌍끌이 순매도'가 지수를 끌어내림. 외국인이 선물 숏 포지션을 대량 구축 → 프로그램 비차익 매도 알고리즘 발동 → 현물 동반 폭락의 '수급 스퀴즈' 구도. 삼성전자 -7.82%, SK하이닉스 -9.75% 급락하며 반도체 대형주가 낙폭 주도, SK하이닉스가 삼성전자를 제치고 시총 1위 탈환. KOSDAQ 824.46(-1.17%). 이례적 대목은 원/달러 환율 1,398.10원(-13.20원, 원화 강세)에도 증시가 폭락했다는 점 — 통상 환율 하락 시 외국인 자금 유입 기대에 증시가 오르는 패턴과 정반대. 오늘(8/20) 장에서는 기술적 반등 여부와 외국인 선물 숏 청산이 관건.

overseas.keyStocks: 미 증시 3대 지수 일제 하락 — 중동 정세 불안·미 국채금리 급등이 압박, 나스닥 -1.33%로 낙폭 최대. 장중 30년물 국채금리가 5.333%까지 치솟아 2007년 이후 최고치를 경신했으나, 미 재무부가 장기채 바이백(조기 환매) 규모를 2배 이상 확대하면서 5.194%까지 후퇴, 증시 낙폭 축소. WSJ의 '빅테크 3조달러 부외 AI 약정' 보도에 메모리주 급락(샌디스크 -9%, 마이크론 -7%). 기술주 중심 차익실현 매물 출회. 베센트 재무장관의 바이백 카드가 금리·증시 안정 여부의 분수령.

morning.insight:
📉 증시 대폭락 — 공포에 매수할 타이밍인가?

어제 코스피는 무려 5.8% 폭락했습니다. 7월 말 서킷브레이커 이후 가장 큰 낙폭입니다. 가장 주목할 점은 환율이 하락(원화 강세)했음에도 증시가 폭락했다는 점입니다. 이는 '펀더멘털 악화'보다는 수급 스퀴즈(외국인·프로그램 매도 동맹)에 의한 기술적 폭락에 가깝습니다.

오늘 13:00에 AWS 미팅이 잡혀 있습니다. 클라우드/AI 관련 논의가 예상되는 만큼, 미팅 준비를 위해 AWS 서비스 업데이트와 제니엘 AX 관련 자료를 챙겨두시는 게 좋겠습니다.

저녁 19:00에는 염동성·임창호 님과 저녁식사 일정이 있습니다. 네트워킹 자리이니 편안한 분위기로 임하시길 바랍니다.

🎯 오늘의 체크리스트
- 코스피 급락 — 급한 대응보다 상황 관찰 (기술적 조정 가능성)
- 13:00 AWS 미팅 준비
- 19:00 염동성·임창호 저녁식사
- Apple 영수증 확인

articles.headline: Global Government Bond Yields Hit Multiyear Highs
articles.eng: 글로벌 국채금리, 수년래 최고치
articles.body: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 5.333% in overnight trade before receding to 5.284%, still close to its 2007 highs, as investors grappled with deficits and inflation.

articles.headline: Tech Stocks Slide With Global Bond Selloff Picking Up Steam
articles.eng: 글로벌 채권 매도세 확산에 기술주 하락
articles.body: Growing fiscal deficits, inflation fears and massive AI spending pushed borrowing costs higher, with the capital-hungry AI industry's appetite for debt competing with nation-state borrowers.

articles.headline: What's Behind the Selloff in Chip Stocks?
articles.eng: 반도체주 매도세, 그 배경은?
articles.body: A WSJ report that top tech firms carry $3 trillion in off-balance-sheet AI commitments, plus China's CXMT debut and advanced chipmaking strides, rattled memory and chip stocks.

articles.headline: High Anxiety in the Bond Market
articles.eng: 채권시장의 높은 불안
articles.body: Fiscal deficits, heavy AI borrowing and sticky inflation have pushed long-dated yields to multiyear highs, unsettling investors across global markets.

articles.headline: Trump Pursues November Summit With Kim Jong-un
articles.eng: 트럼프, 김정은과 11월 정상회담 추진
articles.body: The Wall Street Journal reported that Donald Trump is pursuing a summit with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in November, possibly on the sidelines of an APEC gathering in China.

articles.headline: Bessent Deploys Debt Buybacks in Sign of Concern Over Yield Rise
articles.eng: 베센트, 금리 상승 우려 속 국채 바이백 카드 꺼내
articles.body: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent made a fresh attempt to rein in long-term borrowing costs from multiyear highs, sending Treasury yields lower and lifting risk appetite.

articles.headline: Long-Term Debt Costs Soar to Highest in Decades as Bonds Slump
articles.eng: 채권 급락에 장기 차입비용 수십년래 최고
articles.body: Longer-maturity bonds sit at the epicenter of investor angst over inflation and the debt-laden AI boom, pushing government borrowing costs to multidecade highs.

articles.headline: Stocks Rise as Treasury Steps In to Support Bonds: Markets Wrap
articles.eng: 재무부 채권 지원에 주가 반등: 마켓 랩
articles.body: Wall Street staged a rebound after the Treasury said it would boost buybacks of longer-dated bonds. A 30-year bond rally drove yields down 10 basis points to 5.18%, though chipmakers fell.

articles.headline: 'The Treasury Is Watching': Bessent's Buybacks Jolt Bond Market
articles.eng: '재무부가 지켜본다'…베센트 바이백, 채권시장 충격
articles.body: The surprise expansion of debt buybacks jolted the bond market, signaling the Treasury's concern over the rapid rise in long-term yields.

articles.headline: BofA Sees Nvidia Trading at Up to 50% Discount on AI Risks
articles.eng: BofA, AI 리스크로 엔비디아 최대 50% 할인 거래 전망
articles.body: Bank of America analysts see Nvidia trading at a steep discount on concerns about AI spending sustainability and concentration risk in its customer base.

articles.headline: Trump Delays Canada Tariffs
articles.eng: 트럼프, 캐나다 관세 연기
articles.body: President Trump delayed planned tariffs on Canada, touting a last-minute deal, as the stock and bond rout took a breather.

articles.headline: The Rising Stakes of the Global Bond Rout
articles.eng: 고조되는 글로벌 채권 매도 리스크
articles.body: Stocks and bonds rebounded slightly Wednesday after Treasury buybacks sent the 10-year yield down to 4.697%, but chip stocks sold off sharply as AI borrowing concerns lingered.

articles.headline: Bond Sell-Off Sends Borrowing Costs to Highest Level Since 2007
articles.eng: 채권 매도에 차입비용 2007년 이후 최고
articles.body: Yields on the 30-year U.S. Treasury and government bonds worldwide rose to multiyear highs as investors fretted about inflation, deficits and the AI spending boom.

articles.headline: As Iran War Turns Into Economic Battle, a New U.S. Strategy Recalls the Past
articles.eng: 경제전으로 번진 이란전…과거 떠올리는 美 새 전략
articles.body: Seeking to force Iran to accept U.S. terms, the Trump administration has brought back sanctions on Iranian oil and reinstated a naval blockade, echoing earlier pressure campaigns.

articles.headline: An A.I. Tax Boom Could Curtail America's Debt
articles.eng: AI 세수 붐, 미국 부채 줄일까
articles.body: Surging corporate profits and tax receipts from the AI boom are raising hopes that America's fiscal picture could improve faster than expected, easing pressure on long-term yields.

articles.headline: Trump's $47 Billion-Dollar Border Wall Plan
articles.eng: 트럼프의 470억달러 국경장벽 계획
articles.body: The administration is pressing ahead with a roughly $47 billion plan to expand the border wall, reviving a signature first-term pledge amid renewed enforcement push.

articles.headline: Ukrainian Drone Attack Deep Into Russia Is Among Its Deadliest of the War
articles.eng: 우크라이나, 러시아 심장부 드론 공격…전쟁 중 최대 규모
articles.body: A Ukrainian drone strike on an industrial center in Tatarstan killed at least 13 people, marking one of the deadliest attacks deep inside Russian territory of the war.

articles.headline: Trump says he expects to meet with North Korea's Kim Jong Un later this year
articles.eng: 트럼프 "연내 김정은과 회담 기대"
articles.body: President Donald Trump said he expects to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un later this year, a day after attributing cuts to U.S.-South Korea drills to good relations with Pyongyang.

articles.headline: Harvard agrees to pay $53M settlement after body parts stolen from morgue
articles.eng: 하버드, 시신 훼손 사건 5300만달러 합의
articles.body: Harvard University agreed to pay a $53 million settlement after a former employee stole and sold body parts from its morgue, resolving lawsuits from grieving families.

articles.headline: Trump says he has paused 50% Canadian tariffs, touting last-minute deal
articles.eng: 트럼프 "캐나다 50% 관세 잠정 보류"
articles.body: President Trump said he paused steep tariffs on Canada after a last-minute deal, easing trade tensions that had rattled markets.

articles.headline: UAE says it is suspending trade with Iran after missile attack
articles.eng: UAE, 미사일 공격 후 이란과 교역 중단
articles.body: The United Arab Emirates said it is suspending trade with Iran after a missile attack, deepening regional economic fallout from the escalating conflict.

articles.headline: Pennsylvania will sharply limit data center development, expand review process
articles.eng: 펜실베이니아, 데이터센터 개발 대폭 제한
articles.body: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro plans to sharply limit data center development and expand review, as concerns grow over AI-driven energy and water demand.

articles.headline: Trump defends his move to cut back U.S.-South Korea military exercises
articles.eng: 트럼프, 한미 연합훈련 축소 결정 옹호
articles.body: President Trump defended cutting back U.S.-South Korea military exercises, tying the decision both to relations with North Korea and Seoul's refusal to help with the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.headline: US chip stocks slide as government borrowing costs hit multiyear highs
articles.eng: 정부 차입비용 수년래 최고에 미 반도체주 하락
articles.body: US chip stocks slid as government borrowing costs hit multiyear highs, with the AI industry's debt-fueled expansion competing with traditional sovereign borrowers.

articles.headline: US tech stock correction likely, warn ECB economists
articles.eng: ECB 이코노미스트 "미 기술주 조정 가능성" 경고
articles.body: ECB economists warned that a correction in US tech stocks is likely, as lofty valuations collide with rising long-term interest rates.

articles.headline: Stripe to buy start-up OpenRouter in $8bn deal
articles.eng: 스트라이프, 오픈라우터 80억달러에 인수
articles.body: Stripe agreed to buy AI start-up OpenRouter in an $8 billion deal, its largest-ever acquisition, as it expands into the AI economy.

articles.headline: Google strikes $12bn AI chip deal with Marvell
articles.eng: 구글, 마벨과 120억달러 AI 칩 계약
articles.body: Google struck a $12 billion AI chip deal with Marvell, agreeing an expanded partnership that includes an option to buy shares in the US chipmaker.

articles.headline: Chinese humanoid robot maker surges 600% in trading debut
articles.eng: 중국 휴머노이드 로봇업체, 상장 첫날 600% 급등
articles.body: A Chinese humanoid robot maker surged 600% in its trading debut, underscoring investor frenzy around robotics and AI hardware.

articles.headline: China eases limits on Nvidia H200 chips as AI race escalates
articles.eng: 중국, AI 경쟁 격화 속 엔비디아 H200 제한 완화
articles.body: Beijing permitted small shipments of Nvidia H200 chips to help leading Chinese tech groups in their drive to catch up with US rivals.
